title: Watersound 57 Salt Box Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Private pool **Pool heating is available Oct 1–May 1 for $30 per day**- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private Deeded Beach Access- Access to the Dunesider Pool- Free WiFi- 4 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant—All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutThis property comes with 3 designated parking spaces. This home permits a maximum of 3 vehicles through the community security gate.DETAILS: This gorgeous WaterSound home at 57 Box Lane sleeps 10 and is nestled among native pine and palmetto, yet is close to private beach access and the Dunesider pool. The 4–bedroom, 4.5–bathroom home has an inviting screened porch, luxurious pool, and balcony.A deep screened front porch welcomes guests with cushioned wicker chairs and ceiling fans. It’s the kind of porch that invites laughter and discussions that go long into the night. Stepping inside, guests will discover a lovely open living, dining, and kitchen space that is filled with natural light. Bright white shiplap walls, warm wood floors, and exposed cypress beams are a luxurious backdrop to pops of blue, yellow, and orange from the dining table’s glass chandelier and the coastal artwork adorning the walls. 2 sofas, cozy armchairs, and window seats surround a gas fireplace and flat-screen TV in the living area. A stone-topped dining table seats 7 and rubs shoulders with a marble-topped island with seating for 4. Premium stainless-steel appliances, a farmhouse sink, wine chiller, and gas range are surrounded by white marble countertops and sleek, pale gray cabinets. Past the kitchen is a laundry room with cheery, sea-glass green cabinets, a guest bedroom with a queen bed, and a private bathroom with a shower. An exterior door by the laundry room opens out onto the back patio and pool. Guests will love the outdoor shower, outdoor premium gas grill and wet bar area, and the deep blue pool with its sun shelf.3 bedrooms are on the second floor. A landing at the top of the stairs has a comfy sofa and a bunk room with a built in full bed and a twin bed. A spacious primary bedroom has a king bed and access to a balcony with views of the pool and patio. The room’s private bathroom has a large walk-in closet and a glass-enclosed shower. A bright blue guest bedroom with a king bed is perfect for younger guests who don’t mind a shared bathroom with a shower/tub combo. A second guest bedroom has a queen bed and a private bathroom with a shower.Guests will enjoy exploring WaterSound, the shops at The Hub, or the 30A bike path on 4 included adult bikes. The home’s free WIFI keeps everyone connected. With amenities like these, 57 Salt Box Lane won’t be available for long. Call to book your ultimate vacation today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 10)FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared With Shower/Tub Combo- Bunk Room: Built in Full Bed and Twin Bed*Unfortunately, the fireplace, firepit, and private pool spa are not for guest use.*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
